subject: Travel update and extra fee
text:
Quick update and sorry for the scattered details. I was hoping we could still meet after the museum stop, but the train change is now unclear and I might miss the first entry. Worse, the hotel just added a small city fee that was not shown when I booked, so my budget is suddenly tighter than planned. Do you still want to split the evening taxi, or should I walk and keep things simpler? I can forward the revised route when I find it, though I may need another ten minutes to check the platform.

Thanks,
